en.headline: 354 commits, 4 PRs and 50 issues across OpenCode tooling and skill repos
en.teaser: A month of building OpenCode skills and plugins, filing detailed bug reports against OpenChamber and OpenCode, and shipping four releases of meld-deepresearch.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-29 with no missing days. Totals were 354 commits, 4 pull requests, 50 issues and 0 reviews, plus 580 automated commits recorded separately.

### Own projects

Most of the work went into `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where a daily GitHub activity report was added: a Pages site with an AI summary, a workflow that supports manual date input, a switch to rolling two-hour updates, and several rounds of fixes for dark-mode readability, inline Markdown rendering in the AI summary and the headline contract.

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` moved from 0.1.0 to 0.4.0. The releases added rules for handling blocked sources, validator messages that explain how to fix a failure, a split into three cooperating skills, and a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the six gates. The landing page was redesigned with scroll-linked motion.

`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` was started from scratch: an MV3 skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting and a circuit breaker, JSDoc type checking and a DOM smoke test. Selection translation was dropped in favour of page translation only.

### OpenCode tooling

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, and published 0.1.0-rc.0, 0.1.0-rc.1, 0.2.0 and 1.0.0. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` collected knowledge notes on OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication, Windows path issues and remote branch deletion. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` added agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts and released v1.3.0 and v1.4.0. `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` shipped v1.15.4 and v1.15.5 with corrected skill invocation facts, and `sogeisetsu/myBlog` gained OpenChamber capture samples.

### Upstream reporting

Outside own repositories, 24 issues went to `openchamber/openchamber` and 12 to `anomalyco/opencode`, covering session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context panel percentages, browser capture resolution, model switching and MiMo vision handling. Four pull requests were closed in `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator`, fixing review server disposal, CRLF frontmatter, platform-specific browser commands and eval robustness.

highlights.text: v0.4.0 introduced the meld.py CLI wrapping all six gates behind one --outdir.
First stable release of the skill_management plugin, freezing the 1.x surface.
Shared JSON and proxy helpers, fuller agent discovery with skippedBuiltins reporting.
Reported that the session retention hint still describes the old archived-sessions checkbox.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects images.
Closed a PR hardening eval robustness in parsing, aggregation and install.
Tracked an AI narrative generation failure in the daily report pipeline.

zh.headline: 354 次提交、4 个 PR、50 个 issue，集中在 OpenCode 工具与技能仓库
zh.teaser: 这个月主要开发 OpenCode 技能与插件，向 OpenChamber 和 OpenCode 提交详细缺陷报告，并发布四个版本的 meld-deepresearch。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-09-30 至 2026-10-29，没有缺失日期。总计 354 次提交、4 个 PR、50 个 issue、0 次评审，另有 580 次自动提交单独统计。

### 自有项目

工作量最大的是 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，新增了每日 GitHub 活动日报：Pages 站点加 AI 摘要、工作流支持手动指定日期、改为每 2 小时滚动更新，并多轮修复深色模式可读性、AI 摘要内联 Markdown 渲染和 headline 契约问题。

`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 从 0.1.0 迭代到 0.4.0。各版本加入了无法打开来源的处理规则、能说明如何修复失败的校验提示、拆分为三个协作技能，以及用 `meld.py` 统一封装六道关卡的精简 CLI；落地页也改为滚动联动动效。

`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 从零起步：MV3 骨架、带预设与术语表的 provider 协议层、支持分块与熔断的双语页面渲染、JSDoc 类型检查和 DOM 冒烟测试，并去掉了划词翻译，只保留整页翻译。

### OpenCode 工具链

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四项操作，并发布 0.1.0-rc.0、0.1.0-rc.1、0.2.0 和 1.0.0。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 整理了 OpenCode V2 分发、认证、Windows 路径坑与远程分支删除的知识笔记。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 新增 agent 发现与快照摘要脚本，发布 v1.3.0 和 v1.4.0。`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5，修正技能调用说明；`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 补充了 OpenChamber 截图样例。

### 上游反馈

自有仓库之外，向 `openchamber/openchamber` 提交 24 个 issue，向 `anomalyco/opencode` 提交 12 个，涉及会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板百分比、浏览器截图分辨率、模型切换和 MiMo 视觉处理。`antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 有 4 个 PR 关闭，修复了评审服务器释放、CRLF frontmatter、平台相关浏览器命令和评测健壮性。

highlights.text: v0.4.0 引入 meld.py CLI，用一个 --outdir 封装全部六道关卡。
skill_management 插件首个稳定版，冻结 1.x 对外接口。
共享 JSON 与代理辅助函数，agent 发现更完整并报告 skippedBuiltins。
报告会话保留提示仍在描述旧的“仅归档会话”复选框。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声称支持图片输入，但 Go 端点拒绝所有图片。
关闭了一个加固解析、聚合与安装环节评测健壮性的 PR。
记录了日报流水线中 AI 叙述生成失败的问题。
